mainText: Hello, Verona! At 11 PM, here is today's balanced dish: it is 32 degrees with clear skies observed at Verona Area High School. We are currently under a waning crescent moon phase, and with no rain expected overnight, temperatures will reach a low of 31 degrees.

Public works officials have announced that pavement repairs are scheduled for November 10 and 11. Crews will be milling and patching several streets, including Morningside Boulevard and Mozart Street, so please watch for temporary parking restrictions from 7 AM to 7 PM.

Looking ahead, tomorrow features the Dane County Farmers Market as well as live music at Bailey's Run and Paddy Mac's. Looking further into next week, you can join us for trivia on November 11 at Hop Haus, Wisconsin Brewing Company, and Paddy Mac's.
In a recent report, officers handled a variety of calls including one on October 25 where a man was arrested for O W I after being located at the intersection of Plympton Street and Rita Avenue.
Today was a treat with the Chocolate Volcano flavor, but since we are closed for the night, we look forward to serving you the Andes Mint Avalanche when we open tomorrow at 10:00 AM.
